Can I target a model that is partly obscured by terrain?
✦

It depends on whether the model is visible.

A model is visible if any part of it can be seen from any part of the observing model. If it is completely hidden, it is not visible.

“Visible” and “fully visible” are different conditions. For the latter, the entire model must be in view.

Terrain rules may affect how visibility is determined. Check the terrain feature before resolving the attack.
